stories.name: Island
stories.text: A canal widens into a still pool between the towers, its water clear and cold. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.

stories.name: Downsize
stories.title: A shrinking hex
stories.text: A bruiser twice your size is shaking down a fishmonger by the canal. A thin Azorius clerk watches from a bridge, a spell ready on her lips. She can take the strength out of his arms. She asks if you will help her hold him.

choices.text: Stand beside her and face him

outcome.text: Her spell and your nerve have to hold together.

huge_success.text: His punches land like pillows. The fishmonger pays you both, and the clerk shares her spell.

success.text: His blows go weak and he flees. The clerk shows you how she did it.

failure.text: The spell misses, and his fist does not. The clerk calls the watch and you limp away.

choices.text: Ask her to teach you the spell

outcome.text: She writes the words on a slip of paper while the bruiser shrinks back into the crowd.

choices.text: Stay out of it

outcome.text: You leave the canal behind.

stories.name: Blustersquall
stories.title: Weather from Nivix
stories.text: A gale tears down the street out of nowhere. Market stalls tip and people freeze in place, arms over their faces. On a rooftop, an Izzet weathermage fiddles with a brass coil. The storm is hers, and it is getting away from her.

choices.text: Climb up and help her steady the coil

outcome.text: The coil bucks and sparks as you grab it.

huge_success.text: The wind drops at once. She is so grateful she gives you the spell and her spare rations.

success.text: The squall dies to a breeze. She lets you keep her notes on the spell.

failure.text: A gust throws you off the roof. You land in an awning and limp away.

huge_failure.text: The coil bursts and the gale scatters your pack across the district.

choices.text: Show your Izzet favour and ask for the spell

outcome.text: She recognises a fellow enthusiast and hands you the formula, still crackling.

choices.text: Shelter in a doorway

outcome.text: You wait out the storm and move on.

stories.name: Faerie Impostor
stories.intro: A cloaked faerie flits out of a Tin Street shop with someone else's purse. It sees you watching. It swoops at you, trying to swap your coin for a pebble.
stories.win: The faerie gives up the purse and settles on your shoulder. It will steal for you now, if you let it.
stories.lose: It leaves you dazed and lighter, laughing as it goes.
stories.flee: You clutch your pockets and hurry off.

stories.name: Inaction Injunction
stories.title: An injunction to stand still
stories.text: An Azorius lawmage reads an injunction aloud in a crowded square. Each person she names stops moving and cannot lift a hand. A Rakdos thug is frozen mid-swing. Then she reaches the next line, and it is your name.

choices.text: Ask to read the injunction yourself

outcome.text: You find a misspelling in your name. She strikes it out, sighs, and gives you a blank copy to fill in.

choices.text: Fight the spell as it closes

outcome.text: The words try to pin your limbs.

success.text: You shake it off. Impressed, she lets you keep the scroll.

failure.text: You stand frozen until the spell lapses, and your pack is lighter.

huge_failure.text: You freeze in the sun for hours and a pickpocket helps himself.

choices.text: Slip away before she finishes

outcome.text: You are out of earshot before your name is read.

stories.name: Cyclonic Rift
stories.title: A tear in the air
stories.text: An Izzet experiment has gone wrong in a courtyard. A spinning rift hangs in the air, pulling loose crates, carts and pets toward it. Things that fall in come out somewhere else in the city. A goblin chemister is shouting for someone to close it.

choices.text: Throw yourself at the rift and seal it

outcome.text: The pull is fierce.

huge_success.text: The rift folds shut in your hands. The goblin pays you and gives you the formula.

success.text: You close it with a crack. The goblin hands you the formula before anyone else asks.

failure.text: The rift spits you out across the courtyard and closes on its own.

huge_failure.text: It swallows your pack and drops it who knows where.

choices.text: Help the goblin with his notes

outcome.text: Together you find the error, and the rift snaps shut. He gives you a copy of the spell.

choices.text: Get clear of the courtyard

outcome.text: You leave before it pulls you in.

stories.name: Stealer of Secrets
stories.intro: A woman with ink-stained fingers falls into step beside you. She knows your name, and she wants to know the rest. Her knife comes out when you refuse.
stories.win: She laughs and puts away the knife. She will share what she hears, if you keep her secret.
stories.lose: She leaves you bleeding and knowing more about you than you would like.
stories.flee: You lose her in the crowd, or she lets you think so.

stories.name: Cancel
stories.title: Forbidden
stories.text: A magistrate from Opal Lake stands in the street, cancelling spells as people cast them. A healer's charm fizzles, then a lamplighter's flame. "It is forbidden," he says. He has not said why.

choices.text: Cast a spell at him and see

outcome.text: He raises a hand to stop it.

success.text: He is too slow. He grunts and teaches you the counter, so you can stop the next one yourself.

failure.text: Your spell turns back on you. He writes you a fine.

choices.text: Show your Azorius standing

outcome.text: He nods. A loyal citizen should know how to forbid things too. He shares the counter.

choices.text: Do as he says

outcome.text: You keep your hands still and walk on.

stories.name: Hover Barrier
stories.intro: A shimmering wall of glass drifts across the alley, humming. It hangs at head height and will not let you pass. It has been put here to keep the rumours out.
stories.win: The barrier cracks and then mends, now keyed to you. It will guard your back.
stories.lose: It bounces you into the gutter.

stories.name: Runewing
stories.intro: A bird with runes on its feathers lands on a library sill. It shrieks when you come near its nest of stolen scrolls. It dives at your eyes.
stories.win: The runewing settles. It sheds a quill that writes in a hand not your own.
stories.lose: Its beak finds your scalp, and you retreat from the sill.
stories.flee: You back off and leave it with its scrolls.

stories.name: Inspiration
stories.title: A journal of ideas
stories.text: A frazzled Izzet scholar sits on a step, flipping through a journal backwards. His latest experiment worked, he says, a day before he tried it. He offers to share an idea, if you can help him sort the pages.

choices.text: Help him put the journal in order

outcome.text: You sort the pages by date. He shares his best idea, a spell that brings clarity.

choices.text: Ask him to show you the experiment

outcome.text: He shows you. Your mind fills with ideas, and he lets you keep the spell.

choices.text: Leave him to his paradox

outcome.text: You decide this is a problem for yesterday.

stories.name: Soulsworn Spirit
stories.intro: A pale spirit bound by a Senate oath drifts through a wall toward you. You cannot block it, and you cannot outrun it. Its touch slows your limbs to stillness.
stories.win: The spirit's oath shifts to you. It will follow your orders now.
stories.lose: Its cold touch holds you until it loses interest.
stories.flee: You break the hold and run through a door it does not pass.

stories.name: Voidwielder
stories.intro: A guildless mage with a wild stare blocks the bridge. "I make my own laws," he says. He flicks a hand, and your companion is gone, sent back to where you met them.
stories.win: The Voidwielder concedes the bridge. Outlaws respect strength, and he offers to ride with you.
stories.lose: He sends you tumbling back down the street.
stories.flee: You retreat before he can send you away himself.

stories.name: Isperia's Skywatch
stories.intro: A knight on a winged mount circles low over the Senate roofs. She spots you and dives. Her lance glows, and a pale light grips your arms.
stories.win: She lands and salutes. She will patrol the skies for you now.
stories.lose: The light pins you while she writes up a fine.
stories.flee: You duck under the eaves where her mount cannot follow.

stories.name: Skyline Predator
stories.intro: A shadow falls over you with no warning. A great winged beast drops from the skyline, faster than an arrow. It means to flatten you.
stories.win: The predator lands and folds its wings, beaten. It hunts for you now.
stories.lose: It knocks you flat and takes back to the sky.
stories.flee: You dive under a bridge before it comes round again.

stories.name: Paralyzing Grasp
stories.title: Held in place
stories.text: A goblin stands frozen beside a forge, hands stuck to a lever. A pale hex holds him there. A chamberlain of Niv-Mizzet says the Firemind's mission is worth a few goblins. The goblin begs you with his eyes.

choices.text: Break the hex

outcome.text: The hex fights back as you pry at it.

huge_success.text: The hex snaps free in your hands. The goblin thanks you with his wages.

success.text: The goblin stumbles free. You keep the hex, wound around your fingers.

failure.text: The hex stings you and holds fast. The goblin stays.

huge_failure.text: The hex jumps to your arms for an hour, and your supplies spoil.

choices.text: Bribe the chamberlain to release him

outcome.text: The chamberlain pockets your gold and hands you the hex in a glass jar.

choices.text: Walk on

outcome.text: The goblin's eyes follow you out.
